candidate_meaning.isolated_worker: VIA-owned Agent client in a supervised worker process
candidate_meaning.same_process: the same VIA-owned Agent client in the Core process

fixed_context.semantic_model: one shared Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M local runtime; semantic records are diagnostic only
fixed_context.downstream_agent: same external deterministic Reference Agent implementation and contract; normal and fault strata use separate fresh persistent state files so workload history is not a hidden variable
fixed_context.task_authority: same Task/run binding, command identity and recovery oracle
fixed_context.changed_axis: only the OS process boundary of the VIA-owned Agent client

aggregation.blast_radius: maximum excess affected independent user-visible units
aggregation.memory: nearest-rank p95 of candidate-owned process RSS plus the one shared local semantic runtime
aggregation.trace: 100 * complete scored runtime/fault records / all scored runtime/fault records
aggregation.reproduction: exact independent analyzer reproduction of the frozen core summary

QA-03.method: physical audible status endpoint not implemented

QA-05.method: physical audible control endpoint not implemented

failure_treatment: All errors and timeouts remain in raw evidence; no successful-sample filtering.
source_reuse: Common executions are stored once and mapped with source_execution_key; they are not duplicated as independent samples.
limitations: This campaign deliberately does not score proxy Voice endpoints as QA-01~05.
The deterministic Reference Agent validates the VIA boundary, not third-party Agent reasoning quality.

Semantic, normal-path correctness, design-ledger and exposure records are retained as diagnostics but are not promoted to QA values where the active contract is incomplete or structurally non-applicable.
